messages:
ana-cs: HavenAI just flagged higher tail latency from LatAm users during onboarding tests. They asked if we can do a soft QPS bump on the LATAM edge + add a peering route. Renewal touchpoint in ~45d so want to keep them happy. Can ops/infra help?

mike-sre: copying infra. do we have concrete numbers from their tests? current qps cap for that tenant is 300 qps, currently hitting ~420 spikes. propose a temporary bump to 1200 qps for 72h with auto-revert. :hourglass:

raj-eng: what endpoint/model are they using? heavy token-gen or embeddings? if it's chat-gen we should route to the lower-latency replica or pin to a dedicated pool. also need IP allowlist for peering.

ana-cs: they're on chat-v2 (open model), long-turn convo workload. token rates ~1.2M/day projected. I'll pull logs and the sample traces.

helena-cs: i scheduled an enablement call tomorrow 10:30AM PT to show best-practices on batching/prefix-cache. also flagged renewal team to keep this as a positive touchpoint.

mike-sre: infra-bot, can you stage a temp rate increase + create a peering request ticket? want TTL 72h and auto-revert. include IPs to allowlist.

infra-bot: queued: create_ticket -> #INFRA-4621, action: temp_qps_change, qps:1200, ttl:72h, auto_revert:true

mike-sre: adding the three IPs they provided for peering: ```203.0.113.45/32
198.51.100.12/32
198.51.100.13/32``` please verify and apply to latam-edge egress allowlist.

raj-eng: if we pin to dedicated pool we can keep qps high without impacting other tenants. but that needs approval from capacity planning. for now temp bump + allowlist is low-friction.

ana-cs: noted. customer also reported a 150-200ms RTT improvement when requests crossed the new peering in the lab. that's why they want peering in prod.

mike-sre: i'll apply the temp qps change and add the allowlist in the next maintenance window (in 20m). will post deploy logs here. if any SLO regressions, rollback immediate.

infra-bot: deploy started -> apply_rate_limit_change --tenant=havenai --qps=1200 --ttl=72h

infra-bot: deploy success -> rate_limit_updated, previous=300, current=1200, expires=3300077199 (72h). ticket #INFRA-4621 updated.

helena-cs: great, i'll update the customer that the bump is live and confirm if they see the latency improvement. will capture feedback in the renewal tracker. :tada:

raj-eng: one more ask — can cs ask them to run a short 30m synthetic test and share traces? that'll help decide if we need a permanent peering or dedicated capacity.

ana-cs: on it. sending test plan now. thanks team! :pray:
